# PR #1812: Patch: the card scripts' tests read def ids through the crate's one helper instead of about 130 hand-written copies

Closes #1798

## What changed

The test modules under `crates/cards/src/scripts/` now get their lists of def ids from the crate's shared helper, `crate::def_ids` (`crates/cards/src/lib.rs`), instead of writing the code out again. 86 files change (474 lines added, 612 removed), and nothing changes outside their `#[cfg(test)]` modules.

- **Inline copies replaced.** Every `s.hand(..)` / `s.pile(..)` followed by `.iter()` or `.into_iter()`, `.map(|card| card.def_id…)` and `.collect…` becomes `def_ids(&s.hand(..))` or `def_ids(&s.pile(..))`, with its arguments unchanged. Where such a chain filled a `let x: Vec<String>`, the annotation is dropped, since `collect` no longer needs it to infer the type.
- **52 local wrappers deleted**, with their calls rewritten in the same form. Examples are `hand_defs`, `library_defs`, `defs`, `defs_of`, `defs_in`, `hand_def_ids`, `def_ids_in_hand` and `hand_ids`. Two of them, Voidwalker's and Spell Tyrant's, were local `def_ids` that hid the shared one.
- **Two local helpers kept, under names that hide nothing:**
  - Eugenics' helper sorts its result; it becomes `sorted_def_ids`, and its body now calls the shared `def_ids`.
  - Lane Eater's maps `Vec<Option<CardInstance>>`; it becomes `slot_def_ids`, with its body unchanged.
- **Import added.** Each file that now calls the helper gets `use crate::def_ids;`, as the 17 files that already use it have it. Lane Eater gets none, because it doesn't call it.
- **Left as they are:** the three chains that do more than list ids (Risky Die's pairs each id with `cost_mod`; Mommy Barker's and Prime Time's filter after the map), the `grape_ids` helpers, and helpers over instance ids.

No test name, assertion or expected value changed, and no card script, catalog entry, patch fragment or spec note did either.

All run on the final tree:

- **Same test list:** `cargo test -p jackioh-cards -- --list | grep ': test$' | sort`, run before and after, gives 7004 names both times, and `diff` prints nothing.

- **Patches and catalog:** `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh catalog check` pass.
- **Tools crate:** its code reads the script files, so I also ran `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: 397, 20, 1 and 4 passed. The 4 ignored are the existing daily tests.

  - The scan for `.hand(..)` / `.pile(..)` chains finds only Mommy Barker's and Prime Time's filtering chains.
- **Only test code changed:** for each of the 86 files, the text above its first `#[cfg(test)]` is the same as on `main`.

- **Formatting:** `cargo fmt` never reaches the card scripts, because they come into the crate through a generated `include!`. `cargo fmt --check` passes however they are laid out, and the plan's "run `cargo fmt`" step did nothing.

# #1798: Patch: the card scripts' tests read def ids through the crate's one helper instead of about 130 hand-written copies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The tests beside each card's script often need the list of which cards are in a player's hand, graveyard or deck. The cards crate already has one small helper for exactly that. Most tests write it out again by hand anyway, and many define a private copy under a dozen different names; a few of those copies even hide the shared one. Once built, they all call the shared helper. The tests stay the same, with fewer lines and one spelling for a reader, or the next card's author, to copy.

## Why
- `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:267-271` already has it: `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fn def_ids(cards: &[CardInstance]) -> Vec<String>`.
- Searching `crates/cards/src/scripts` for `.hand(..)` or `.pile(..)` followed by `.iter()` or `.into_iter()` and `.map(|c| c.def_id…)` finds 131 copies in 77 files.
- 41 of those copies are local helper functions with that one-line body, in 37 files. Examples:
  - `hand_defs` (`classic/c009_income_tax.rs:240`)
  - `hand_ids` (`core/c098_heroic_power.rs:232`), which returns def ids despite its name
  - `def_ids_in_hand` (`core/c037_gravedigger.rs:83`)
  - `hand_def_ids` (`core/c051_kys_private_tutor.rs:411`)
- Four files declare their own `fn def_ids`, with different signatures, that hides the crate's: `classic/c050_voidwalker.rs:85`, `classic/c056_spell_tyrant.rs:113`, `classic/c071_lane_eater.rs:140` and `core/c042_eugenics.rs:196`.
- #1786 did the same for the engine's rule tests, taking `both`, `spread` and the JSON helpers from the shared harness.

## Proposal
- Mechanically replace each copy with `def_ids(&s.hand(P))` or `def_ids(&s.pile(P, "graveyard"))`, and delete the local wrappers.
- Rename or remove the four shadowing `def_ids`. Keep a local helper only where its signature really differs (Lane Eater's `Vec<Option<…>>`), under a name that hides nothing.
- Only `#[cfg(test)]` code changes. No script, test name or assertion changes.

## Where it lands
- The test modules under `crates/cards/src/scripts/**`, about 77 files
- CLAUDE.md rule 6 (a card's tests sit beside its script). No spec change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards -- --list` prints the same test names before and after.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
- [ ] No local function under `crates/cards/src/scripts` has only that `.map(|c| c.def_id…).collect()` as its body, and no script's test module declares its own `fn def_ids`.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` reports no card that plays differently (the change is test-only), and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks
Many files, little substance: mechanical edits to about 77 card files, roughly 200 lines removed. Touching card files runs the whole Rust CI. A careless edit could change an assertion; the unchanged test list and green tests guard against that.
